lines: That taste is not primary — its works,
curing disease and the rest, run by an occult eye.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na hi sa raso mukhyaḥ tatkāryavyādhiśamanādyadṛṣṭeḥ

c1_essence: Taste loses primacy: its works run through an occult eye.
